Patch Set 14:

(2 comments)
dbus interface is going to need to change.
Done
Can you link the PDI change?

PDI: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/90596

TOPIC: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/q/topic:%22PasswordChangeRequired%22

@ed@tanous.net / @gunnar@gmills.xyz

could you review this patch ?
nit, please follow the pattern of returning early (similar to line 1196)
Done
We're now out of sync, in that we support different properties on POST than we do on PATCH.  These should be the same so you can POST a user with PasswordChangeRequired
Done
?  Why can't this be unset?

Per earlier review discussion, we intentionally reject false rather than silently ignoring it. Allowing false would let an admin programmatically unexpire a password, which is a security regression.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/90596/comment/c9b2ceee_67d11f0b/
I don't understand that, but sure, that's a decision for phosphor-user-manager to make.  Please just make sure that the error is handled properly in bmcweb, don't try to pre-check the condition.

agree to drop the pre-check.
dbus returns xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed for a false, and error in the callback will map to propertyValueNotInList(asyncResp->res, false, "PasswordChangeRequired").

Does this map okay?, or do we have any concerns with this error mapping?
that seems fine.
Pass by const reference please.
Done
This is now duplicated.  Please deduplicate
Done
Please make this follow the same pattern as handleUserNameAttrPatch, deduplicating between patch/post.
Done
Is there a reason we can't require password change here and have to set it separately?

CreateUser2 does not support UserPasswordExpired as a UserProperty in the D-Bus interface only UserPrivilege, UserGroups, UserEnabled, and PasswordExpiration are supported.
https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/User/Manager.interface.yaml
And that can't be fixed for some architectural reason?

Yes, as of now there are the above mentioned properties are mandatory to create the user.
Adding PasswordChangeRequired as part of CreateUser2 doesn't seem like a great idea, since forcing a password change on next login is not necessarily needed at user creation time.

> since forcing a password change on next login is not necessarily needed at user creation time.

I'm confused.  The whole point of CreateUser2 is that all properties are optional.  if it's not required, then don't set it.
